sections.Profile:
"Darts" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in June 1960. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, five kick-out holes, and a gobble hole.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Darts, Sports, Original Theme
